notes: Two isnads carry the same Prophet's saying on the twelve caliphs (rule 4); the wording differs, the routes do not
Jabir asks his father («فقلت لأبي») and the father's «كلهم من قريش» is a gloss on the saying, not a link (rule 6)
The later «ثم يكون ماذا؟» passage has no transmitter and is not a route
